issues.explanation: Email/password rules live in rules() while name uses #[Validate], splitting validation across two mechanisms instead of the project #[Validate] pattern.
The remember checkbox is a client-writable public bool with no validation rule, so a tampered non-boolean value relies on Livewire type coercion.
Import-only cleanup of provider class references serves no auth requirement.
Whitespace-only changes and an unused-import removal are unrelated hygiene included in an auth change.

conventions.evidence: Livewire uses #[Validate]+validate() (Login.php:241-244), views use route() (e.g. login.blade.php:895-896), redirects use named routes (LogoutController.php:125, Login.php:267), inputs use wire:model (login.blade.php:880-881), Blade components x-auth.card/x-field/x-status; docs synced (CHANGELOG.md:26-28, docs/business-rules.md:472-486). One deviation: Register.php:320-328 name via #[Validate] but email/password only via rules() (Register.php:374-380).

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (Login.php:252-268 submit, Register.php:332-364 submit, PasswordResetController.php:184-216 update), clear names (throttleKey, ensureIsNotRateLimited), PHPDoc on controllers, consistent sibling style, no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: Login: Login.php:52-68 attempt/regenerate/redirectIntended(home) + throttleKey Login.php:290-293 lower+transliterate, 5 tries, auth.failed/auth.throttle. Register: Register.php:334-364 key str()->transliterate('register|'.ip), 5 tries, unique+confirmed+Password::defaults (AppServiceProvider.php:427), Registered+login+regenerate. Routes web.php:938-963 match contract names/paths/throttle/signed. Reset view has single name="email" (reset-password.blade.php:733) + remember_token rotation (PasswordResetController.php:195-200). Verification via EmailVerificationRequest (EmailVerificationController.php:78-83). Locale pins (.env.example:6-15, phpunit.xml:694-695) + ui.php both locales.

scope.evidence: Diff serves auth+i18n task (controllers, Livewire, routes, lang/en+pt_BR/ui.php, views, auth tests, business-rules/CHANGELOG docs). Exceptions are trivial unrelated cleanups: bootstrap/providers.php:454-462 import style, lang/pt_BR whitespace-only hunks, tests/Feature/BulmaTest.php:1611 import removal.

security.evidence: EmailVerificationRequest authorizes id/hash (tampered id 403, verified by EmailVerificationTest.php:1019-1029); forgot-password always flashes passwords.sent (PasswordResetController.php:161-168); reset maps InvalidUser to InvalidToken (PasswordResetController.php:208-211); strict email:rfc,strict everywhere; Password::defaults min8+letters+mixedCase+numbers; RateLimiter on login/register + throttle:6,1 middleware; session regenerate/invalidate+regenerateToken; views use {{ }} auto-escaping.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Password broker, EmailVerificationRequest, RateLimiter, Password::defaults, and new x-auth.card/x-field/x-status components; no service/repository layers, no speculative abstractions; PasswordResetController.php:192-202 and Livewire actions are minimum code that works.

tests.evidence: Pest tests cover happy/validation/failure paths: LoginTest.php rate-limit/clear/intended/remember, RegisterTest.php unique/confirmed/default-rule/ip-limit + persistent-middleware assertion (RegisterTest.php:1600-1603), EmailVerificationTest.php tampered-id/hash/unsigned/throttle/resend, PasswordResetTest.php enumeration/throttle/remember-rotation, plus LocalizationTest and ViewConventionsTest. Missing a direct authenticated-user Livewire submit() denied call (only GET redirect + middleware-presence asserted).

review.summary: Implements the full session auth flow (Livewire login/register, logout, forgot/reset password, verification, pt-BR default) per the contract with strong security and i18n handling. Tests are extensive but lack a direct authenticated Livewire submit denial test, plus minor convention/scope nits, so approve with nits.
